title: Maha Kalpa and Maha Pralaya: Indian Cosmic Cycle – Concept Paper
content: This concept paper proposes a novel two-universe model inspired by ancient Indian cosmology. Our model challenges the traditional notion of a universe destined for heat death and offers a new perspective on the cyclical nature of the cosmos, aligning with ancient Indian concepts of cyclical time and the dynamic interplay of creation and dissolution. It also makes testable predictions that could be investigated through future research, potentially leading to a deeper understanding of the universe's fate. This concept paper provides a compelling framework for future research and encourages further exploration of the connections between ancient wisdom and modern science, potentially leading to a more holistic and nuanced understanding of the universe and our place within it.
